title: Big Seaweed Search booklet

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Let a specimen interrupt a headline deliberately, because the image should feel integral without making the subject unclear.
strategic_value: The seaweed crossing the oversized word Big can link a strong editorial hierarchy to the Museum’s natural subject matter.
demonstration: A blue booklet places a white signature at top, oversized turquoise Big lettering behind seaweed and Seaweed Search beneath.
practical_value: Compare image overlap with a clear smaller title and stable signature.

content_islands.name: Publication title
content_islands.spec: Set oversized Big above the smaller Seaweed Search title on blue.

content_islands.name: Specimen overlay
content_islands.spec: Let dark seaweed stems cross the large letters and extend down the cover.

content_islands.name: Signature and object
content_islands.spec: Keep the white museum signature at upper left and visible booklet edges beneath.

reference_purposes.Application: A blue booklet places a white signature at top, oversized turquoise Big lettering behind seaweed and Seaweed Search beneath.
